main.description: Subscriber count for an author, and whether a given reader is among them. Subscriptions are site.standard.graph.subscription records written into readers' own repositories; Chive indexes them from the firehose and neither writes nor owns them.

did.description: DID of the author whose publications are subscribed to

viewerDid.description: Reader to report a subscription status for; omitted when nobody is signed in

subscriberCount.description: Distinct readers subscribed, not records: an author may hold several publications and a reader following two of them is one follower.

subscribed.description: Whether viewerDid subscribes. False when no viewer was given.

publicationUri.description: The author's publication record, when they have one. A reader needs it to write a subscription of their own.
